An [inline link](https://example.com) and one [with a title](https://example.com "the title").

A [reference link][ref] becomes inline, and so does a [collapsed one][].

An autolink <https://example.com/auto> and an email <user@example.com>.

A [Makefile](Makefile) link whose text equals its relative URL must stay an
inline link, never become `<Makefile>`.

An image: ![alt text](image.png "img title")

A [link with a destination that has spaces](</path with spaces>).

A [link with **styled** text](https://example.com/styled) keeps its inline form.

A [`code`](https://example.com/code) link whose only text is a code span also
stays inline.

[ref]: https://example.com/ref
[collapsed one]: https://example.com/collapsed
